gloss: omission in a form; failure to fill in (a field)

definitions.gloss: omission in a form; missing entry; failure to fill in a required field
definitions.explanation: An item or field on a form, application, or document that was accidentally left blank or incomplete.

examples.japanese: {記入漏|きにゅうも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check that nothing has been left blank.

examples.japanese: {記入漏|きにゅうも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{返|かえ}されて→返す：09648_kaesu⟧きた。
examples.english: The documents were returned because there was an omission.

examples.japanese: {提出前|ていしゅつまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記入漏|きにゅうも}れや⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{見直|みなお}しましょう→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: Before submitting, let's review one more time for any omissions or typos.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧ (filling in, writing in) and ⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧ (leak, omission). Refers specifically to accidentally leaving fields blank on forms and paperwork.

USAGE:
Very common in bureaucratic and administrative contexts — government forms, applications, contracts, surveys, etc. Japan's culture of meticulous paperwork makes this a frequently encountered term. Often appears in instructions printed on forms themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記入漏|きにゅうも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — there is an omission
- {記入漏|きにゅうも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ — to check for omissions
- {記入漏|きにゅうも}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ — be careful of omissions
- {記入漏|きにゅうも}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — so as not to leave anything blank

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{漏|も}らし→書き漏らす：26053_kakimorasu⟧ — something left unwritten (more general)
- {未記入|みきにゅう} — unfilled, not yet filled in (more neutral, no implication of error)
- ⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧ — deficiency, incompleteness (broader, covers any problem with documents)
